name: approval-declined
description: The seller declines the confirmed terms with a note. Kritva says kindly that the seller can't do it, passes the note on, makes no new offer, and asks whether it may keep in touch; the buyer's answer is thanked and the negotiation ends without agreement.

turns.buyer: I'll take it at ₹20,000 and pick it up myself.

turns.message: I've decided to keep it for my family for now.

turns.buyer: Sure, you can keep my number.
